# NucleusArt

> NucleusArt (https://nucleusart.studio) is an AI short drama and video ad studio. You paste a story; it writes the screenplay, finds the characters and locations, keeps every character looking the same in every shot, draws a storyboard picture for each shot and turns the scenes into vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

NucleusArt is made by Nucleus LLC. It is used by creators, storytellers, Nollywood-style drama makers and small brands making story-driven video ads.

## What it does
- Story to screenplay: write or paste a few paragraphs; the script, shots and camera directions are written for you.
- Consistent characters: each character gets a reference sheet first, so faces, outfits and places match across shots and episodes.
- Storyboard: a picture for every shot, in a photorealistic film style or anime/comic styles.
- Video: each storyboard frame becomes a video clip (Seedance, Kling and Wan video models); dramas up to 90 seconds per episode.
- Formats: 9:16 vertical, 1:1 and 16:9.
- Transparent pricing: every generate button shows its price in credits before you click.

## Models
Writing: Claude (Opus, Sonnet) and Gemini. Pictures: GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Seedream. Video: Seedance 2.0/2.5, Kling 3.0, Wan 2.6.

## Pricing
- Free: 150 credits on sign-up (script, storyboard and first pictures).
- Starter: $19/month, 500 credits.
- Pro: $49/month, 2,000 credits (about 1 minute of finished video a month).
- Studio: $99/month, 5,000 credits.
- Yearly billing gives two months free. Nigerian customers can pay in naira (Starter ₦28,500/month); Ghana, Kenya, South Africa and other African countries can pay in local currency with mobile money; everyone else pays in USD by card, Apple/Google Pay or crypto.
